tool.name: nf-core qcat
tool.command:
<![CDATA[ ## Unzip fastq file ## qcat doesn't support zipped files yet FILE=$reads if [[ \$FILE == *.gz ]] then zcat $reads > unzipped.fastq FILE=unzipped.fastq fi
qcat \\ -f \$FILE \\ -b ./fastq \\ --kit $barcode_kit
## Zip fastq files gzip fastq/*
cat <<-END_VERSIONS > versions.yml "${task.process}": qcat: \$(qcat --version | sed 's/^.*qcat //; s/ .*\$//') END_VERSIONS ]]>
tool.help:
<![CDATA[ **What it does**
Demultiplexer for Nanopore samples
